Alias `PUT` para `/products/reorder`. Me: Alias `PUT` for `/products/reorder`. Same behavior as the `POST` version.

Altera o vencimento de um pagamento em b: Changes the due date of a pending bank-slip payment issued via the Kobana gateway. The new date must be in the future.
Alternativa a `trial_end`. Dias de trial: Alternative to `trial_end`. Trial days from creation.
Alíquota aplicada em percentual (ex.: `1: Applied rate as a percentage (e.g.: `1.5` for 1.5%).
Alíquota efetiva do Simples Nacional apl: Effective Simples Nacional rate applied in the period (percent).
Alíquota padrão de ISS em pontos percent: Default ISS rate in percentage points (e.g. `2.5` means 2.5%). Decimal with up to two places.
Default ISS rate in percentage points (e.g. `2.5`).

Alíquotas de impostos (em decimal, ex.:: Tax rates (as decimals, e.g.: `0.05` for 5%). Falls back to company defaults when omitted.
Alíquotas e valores de impostos (ISS, PI: Tax rates and amounts (ISS, PIS, COFINS, CSLL, IR, INSS).
Anexo do Simples Nacional aplicável ao s: Simples Nacional annex applicable to the service: `annex_iii`, `annex_iv` or `annex_v`.
Anos a importar. Por omissão, o ano corr: Years to import. Defaults to the current one plus the next two.
Anotações internas (não exibidas ao clie: Internal notes (not shown to the customer).
Apenas letras minúsculas, dígitos e hífe: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
Aplica créditos da conta de cobrança em: Applies billing-account credits to an open (`status = open`) invoice.
Aplica mudanças nos itens da assinatura: Apply changes to the subscription items
Aplica uma ação sobre o período: `recalc: Applies an action to the period: `recalculate` recomputes taxes (monthly periods only), `close` closes the period and `reopen` reopens it.
Aplicações deste crédito em faturas, qua: Applications of this credit to invoices, when the relation is loaded.
Arquiva múltiplos produtos. IDs em uso p: Archives multiple products. IDs in use by active subscriptions or already archived are skipped and reported in the response.
Arquiva o produto. Retorna 422 quando o: Archives the product. Returns 422 when the product is in use by active subscriptions or is already archived.
Archives the product. Returns 422 when the product is in use by active subscriptions.
Arquivo PEM da chave privada (somente pa: Private key PEM file (only for `type=cert_key` or `type=cert_key_password`).
Arquivo binário (PFX/P12) quando `type=p: Binary file (PFX/P12) when `type=pfx`, or combined PEM when `type=combined_pem`.
Assinatura de e-mail configurada pelo us: Email signature configured by the user.
Ativa (`true`) ou desativa (`false`) o i: Activates (`true`) or deactivates (`false`) the service item.
Ativa um template de proposta previament: Activates a previously deactivated proposal template, making it available for use in new proposals.
Ativado a partir desta data (YYYY-MM-DD): Activated on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
Activated on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
Atualiza a Classificação Tributária (cCl: Update the Tax Classification (cClassTrib). Use `null` to clear.
Atualiza a data de expiração. Use `null`: Update the expiration date. Use `null` to clear.
Atualiza a descrição. Use `null` para li: Update the description. Use `null` to clear.
Atualiza a empresa emissora. Use `null`: Update the issuing company. Use `null` to clear.
Atualiza a ordem de exibição dos grupos: Updates the display order of product groups. The `group_ids` array defines the new order — index 0 becomes the first group.
Atualiza a ordem de exibição dos produto: Updates product display order. Array index 0 becomes the first item in the list.
Atualiza a política de NFe. Use `null` p: Update the NF-e policy. Use `null` to clear.
Atualiza a política. Faturas já finaliza: Updates the policy. Invoices already finalized are unaffected: each invoice freezes the policy in force at finalization, so a renegotiation cannot retroactively change what was already issued.
Atualiza a série do RPS. Use `null` para: Update the RPS series. Use `null` to clear.
Atualiza a visibilidade (`public` ou `pr: Updates the visibility (`public` or `private`) of multiple products.
Atualiza apenas mês e ano de validade do: Updates only the expiration month and year of the card tied to the method. Fails when `type` is not `card`.
Atualiza as anotações. Use `null` para l: Update the notes. Use `null` to clear.
Atualiza campos da NFe. Apenas NFes em `: Updates NF-e fields. Only `draft` NF-e accept changes to amounts and fiscal codes.
Atualiza campos editáveis da regra. Quan: Updates editable fields of the rule. When `items` is provided, it **fully replaces** the existing items list.
Atualiza campos editáveis do cupom. `cod: Updates editable coupon fields. `code`, `discount_type`, `discount_value` and `currency` are immutable after creation.
Atualiza campos editáveis do item de ser: Updates editable fields of the service item. `internal_code` is immutable after creation. Use `is_active=false` to deactivate the item without deleting it.
Atualiza em massa a fatura associada aos: Bulk-updates the invoice associated with the given payments. Useful for fixing links when payments arrived pointing to the wrong invoice.
Atualiza nome, foto, status, permissões: Updates the user’s name, picture, status, permissions and/or roles. Only the fields sent are changed.
Atualiza o Indicador de Operação (indOp): Update the Operation Indicator (indOp). Use `null` to clear.
Atualiza o `display_order` dos grupos co: Updates each group `display_order` according to the order of the `group_ids` array. All groups must belong to the current organization.
Atualiza o código CNAE. Use `null` para: Update the CNAE code. Use `null` to clear.
Atualiza o código LC 116. Use `null` par: Update the LC 116 code. Use `null` to clear.
Atualiza o código NBS. Use `null` para l: Update the NBS code. Use `null` to clear.
Atualiza o código NCM. Use `null` para l: Update the NCM code. Use `null` to clear.
Atualiza o fim do período de competência: Update the end of the billing period. Use `null` to clear.
Atualiza o início do período de competên: Update the start of the billing period. Use `null` to clear.
Atualiza o número do RPS. Use `null` par: Update the RPS number. Use `null` to clear.
Atualiza o perfil cadastral da organizaç: Updates the profile of the authenticated organization. Only the fields below can be modified — identity (`id`, `external_id`, `status`) is not changeable through this endpoint.
Atualiza o setup unitário em reais (floa: Update unit setup amount in sub-cents (float, up to 4 decimal places).
Update the NF-e amount in BRL.
Atualiza o valor unitário em reais (floa: Update unit amount in sub-cents (float, up to 4 decimal places).
Atualiza os campos do papel. Apenas os c: Updates the role fields. Only the fields sent are changed. System roles have additional restrictions.
Atualiza parcialmente (PATCH) a configur: Partially updates (PATCH) the organization's plan change configuration. All fields are optional.
Atualiza parcialmente a configuração. Ap: Partially updates the settings. Only supplied fields are changed. `refund_on_remove` requires `credit_on_remove` to also be enabled — refund is a variant of credit.
Atualiza um item. Só é permitido em prop: Updates an item. Only allowed on draft (`status = draft`) proposals.
Atualiza várias NFes de uma vez. Hoje su: Updates multiple NF-e at once. Currently supports linking or unlinking an invoice (`invoice_id`) on up to 100 NF-e per request.
Baixa do provedor o PDF e o XML da NFe e: Downloads the NF-e PDF and XML from the provider and stores them in the database.
Baixa o PDF da NFe (DANFE) como anexo bi: Downloads the NF-e PDF (DANFE) as a binary attachment (`application/pdf`). Served from the database when available; otherwise fetched from the provider.
Baixa o XML da NFe como anexo binário (`: Downloads the NF-e XML as a binary attachment (`application/xml`). Served from the database when available; otherwise fetched from the provider.
Bancos brasileiros com código COMPE (BAC: Brazilian banks with a COMPE code (BACEN), used to register bank accounts. The list is the same for every organization and is refreshed weekly from BrasilAPI.
Base de contagem dos dias de atraso. Ape: Day-count basis for the delay. Only `calendar` is accepted for now: the local accrual has no holiday calendar yet, and counting business days without one would overstate the charge against what the bank collects.
Base de cálculo em reais (float, até 4 c: Calculation base in BRL (float, up to 4 decimal places).
Base de cálculo, em reais (float, até 4: Calculation base, in BRL (float, up to 4 decimal places).
Bloco com dados do meio de pagamento — u: Block with payment method data — used when no `payment_method_id` is provided.
Search by part of the name or code.
Free-text search by name or slug.
Busca textual livre por nome, documento: Free-text search by name, document or email.
Text search by name or description.
Text search by name or email.
Text search by name or slug.
Busca textual por nome, razão social, e-: Free-text search by name, legal name, email or document number.
Busca uma NFS-e no Ambiente de Dados Nac: Fetches an NFS-e from the Ambiente de Dados Nacional (ADN) using a 50-digit access key and a previously registered digital certificate (mTLS authentication).
Busca uma NFS-e no endpoint municipal de: Fetches an NFS-e from the Barueri municipal endpoint using the `codigo_autenticidade` printed on the DANFSE and the taker's CPF/CNPJ. Returns the raw XML and, when found, the NF-e already present in the organization.
CBS devido (reforma tributária 2026+), e: CBS due (2026+ tax reform), in BRL (float, up to 4 decimal places).
COFINS devido no período, em reais (floa: COFINS due for the period, in BRL (float, up to 4 decimal places).
CPF (11 dígitos) ou CNPJ (14 dígitos). P: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits). May include a mask.
CPF ou CNPJ (com ou sem máscara — será n: CPF or CNPJ (with or without mask — will be normalized to digits only).
CPF ou CNPJ do tomador da NFS-e (somente: Taker's CPF or CNPJ (digits only or formatted).
CPF ou CNPJ extraído do certificado (ape: CPF or CNPJ extracted from the certificate (digits only).
CPF ou CNPJ para localizar/criar o custo: CPF or CNPJ to locate/create the customer.
CPF ou CNPJ. O `document_type` é inferid: CPF or CNPJ. The `document_type` is inferred from the length (≤11 → cpf, otherwise cnpj).
CPF/CNPJ do titular, só dígitos. Vazio u: Holder CPF/CNPJ, digits only. Empty uses the document of the issuing company (or the organization).
CSLL devido (estimativa mensal), em reai: CSLL due (monthly estimate), in BRL (float, up to 4 decimal places).
CSRF (PIS/COFINS/CSLL retidos) a compens: CSRF (withheld PIS/COFINS/CSLL) pending compensation, in BRL (float, up to 4 decimal places).
Calcula quanto um saldo devedor deve de: Computes what an outstanding balance owes in fine and interest on a given date, creating nothing. Pass either `policy_id` or an inline `policy`. Use it to reconcile the arithmetic before an invoice actually goes late.
Campo de ordenação. Padrão depende do re: Sort field. Default depends on the resource.
Campos personalizados (validados contra: Custom fields (validated against the organization's schema).
Campos personalizados definidos pela org: Custom fields defined by the organization.
Channel of the last update to the record.
Canal pelo qual o registro foi criado (d: Channel through which the record was created (dashboard, import, api, mcp, cli, other). On API calls it comes from the `X-Request-Source` header.
Cancela imediatamente, ou agenda para o: Cancels immediately, or schedules for end of period when `cancel_at_period_end=true`.
Cancela um pagamento em aberto. Quando `: Cancels an open payment. When `cancel_on_gateway` is `true` (default), the cancellation is propagated to the gateway.
Cancela uma NFe emitida. Enfileira o can: Cancels an issued NF-e. Enqueues the cancellation asynchronously with the provider. The `reason` must be at least 15 characters and is recorded in the audit log.
Cancela uma fatura aberta (`open` → `voi: Voids an open invoice (`open` → `void`). The `reason` is recorded in the audit log.
Cancela uma mudança de itens ainda agend: Cancels an item change that is still scheduled (`timing=end_of_period`). Changes already applied cannot be canceled. Returns the record with its new status.
Cancela várias propostas de uma vez (até: Cancels multiple proposals at once (up to 100). Returns success/failure counts and errors per id.
Cancelado a partir desta data (YYYY-MM-D: Canceled on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
Canceled on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
Cartão alternativo (token e portador) pa: Alternative card (token and holder) for the retry attempt.
Categoria CBS/IBS do item, conforme a re: CBS/IBS category for the item, per the tax reform.
Chave de acesso única da NFe (44 ou 50 d: Unique NF-e access key (44 or 50 digits, depending on the municipality).
Chave de idempotência **obrigatória**. D: Idempotency key **required**. Must be unique across snapshots.
Chave de idempotência fornecida ao criar: Idempotency key provided when creating the payment.
Chave de idempotência opcional. Se já ex: Optional idempotency key. If a record with the same key already exists for the item, returns the existing one with `duplicate: true`.
Chave de idempotência por organização —: Per-organization idempotency key — safely allows retrying the same execution.
Chave de idempotência usada na criação,: Idempotency key used at creation, if any.
Chave de idempotência. O cabeçalho `Idem: Idempotency key. The `Idempotency-Key` header takes precedence over this field.
Key that located the existing customer. `null` when the customer was created.
Chave que localizou o registro existente: Key that located the existing record. `null` when the record was created.
Chave única (UUID v4 recomendado) para r: Unique key (UUID v4 recommended) to safely retry the same request. Requests sharing the key within 24h return the original result.
Chaves Pix da organização para onde os c: The organization Pix keys customers transfer to on a `bank_transfer` charge (`POST /invoices/{id}/pay`).
Ciclo de cobrança da assinatura criada n: Billing cycle of the subscription created on acceptance: `monthly`, `quarterly`, `semiannual` or `annual`.
Classificação Tributária (cClassTrib) do: IBS/CBS Tax Classification (cClassTrib), required alongside the service/NBS code by the tax reform (Anexo VIII).
Classificação tributária (CST IBS/CBS) a: Tax classification (IBS/CBS CST) applicable to the item.
Cobrança adicional por proração em reais: Additional charge from proration in sub-cents (float, up to 4 decimal places).
Cobrança automática na conta criada. Pad: Automatic collection on the created account. Default: `true`.
Cobrança de proporção em reais (float, a: Proration charge in BRL (float, up to 4 decimal places) issued to the customer.
Cobrar os dias acrescentados. Padrão: `t: Bill the added days. Default: `true`, unless the subscription `proration_behavior` is `none`.
Com `payment_method = bank_transfer`: UU: With `payment_method = bank_transfer`: UUID of the organization Pix key the customer should transfer to (see `/pix_keys`). Send this or `bank_account_id`, never both.
With `payment_method = bank_transfer`: UUID of the organization bank account the customer should transfer to (see `/bank_accounts`). Send this or `pix_key_id`, never both.
Como a multa é calculada. Incide uma úni: How the fine is computed. Charged once. `percentage` uses `fine_percent`, `fixed` uses `fine_amount`.
Como o `custom_metadata` enviado é recon: How the submitted `custom_metadata` is reconciled with the stored value. `replace` (default) overwrites the whole object; `merge` deep-merges over the current value — nested objects merge recursively, scalars and arrays overwrite the key, and `null` keys are kept (they do not delete the key). Accepted on update only.
Como os juros de mora correm. Os percent: How interest accrues. The percentage modes use `interest_percent`; `daily_amount` uses `interest_amount`. Interest is charged on the principal alone, never on principal plus fine.
Como tratar faturas geradas durante a pa: How to treat invoices generated during the pause. Default: `mark_uncollectible`.
Comportamento de proração ao trocar de p: Proration behavior when switching plans. `create_prorations` (default): generates an adjustment; `none`: ignores; `always_invoice`: emits an immediate invoice.
Conta de cobrança que efetuou a retenção: Billing account that performed the withholding.
Contas bancárias da organização para ond: The organization bank accounts customers transfer to on a `bank_transfer` charge (`POST /invoices/{id}/pay`).
Converte todas as retenções pendentes da: Converts all of the organization's pending withholdings — optionally narrowed by `tax_type` and/or competence period — into credits. Returns the list of generated credits, the total count converted and the total amount in BRL.
Converte uma retenção (total ou parcialm: Converts a withholding (fully or partially) into a credit on the billing account derived from the associated invoice — or, when absent, from the withholder itself. When `amount` is omitted, converts the withholding's pending balance.
Convida um novo membro para o time da or: Invites a new member to the organization team. `email` and at least one role in `role_ids` are required. The user receives an email invite and starts with `pending_invitation` status.
Convite criado e e-mail enfileirado para: Invitation created and email queued for sending.
Convites pendentes são removidos definit: Pending invitations are permanently removed; active users are suspended.
Cria (ou recupera) o período tributário: Creates (or retrieves) the given monthly tax period and computes the taxes due (ISS, PIS, COFINS, IRPJ, CSLL, CBS, IBS) based on issued NFes and pending compensation. When `company_id` is omitted, uses the organization default company.
Cria ou atualiza (upsert) o perfil fisca: Creates or updates (upsert) the company fiscal profile. Includes taxation regime, rates (ISS, PIS, COFINS, CSLL, IRPJ) and CBS/IBS settings.
Cria ou atualiza um papel de equipe: Create or update a team role
Cria ou atualiza um usuário do painel: Create or update a dashboard user
Cria ou substitui o cronograma de parcel: Creates or replaces the invoice installment schedule. Minimum of 2 installments.
Cria snapshots diários de uso, registro: Creates daily usage snapshots, single record **or** `{ records: [...] }` batch up to **100** items. The natural key (organization, billing account, product, date) is unique: when present, the snapshot is overwritten (`overwritten: true`). Resolve the account by `billing_account_id` **or** `billing_account_public_id` and the product by `product_slug` **or** `product_id` within the supplied `product_group_slug`. Batches with partial failures return **207 Multi-Status**.
Cria snapshots mensais de uso, registro: Creates monthly usage snapshots, single record **or** `{ records: [...] }` batch up to **100** items. The natural key (organization, billing account, product, month) is unique: when present, the snapshot is overwritten (`overwritten: true`). Resolve the account by `billing_account_id` **or** `billing_account_public_id` and the product by `product_slug` **or** `product_id` within `product_group_slug`. Batches with partial failures return **207 Multi-Status**.
Cria um cliente e, por padrão, uma conta: Creates a customer and, by default, an associated billing account. Use `create_billing_account=false` to create only the customer.
Cria um convite de acesso ao portal para: Creates a portal access invitation for the given email. The invitation expires in 7 days.
Cria um cupom de desconto. O `code` deve: Creates a discount coupon. The `code` must be unique per organization. Use `discount_type=percentage` with `discount_value` between `0` and `100`, or `discount_type=fixed_amount` with `discount_value` in BRL (float, up to 4 decimal places).
Cria um feriado. Use para feriados estad: Creates a holiday. Use it for state and municipal holidays and optional days off — the national ones arrive through the automatic import.
Cria um item de serviço no catálogo LC 1: Creates a service item in the LC 116/2003 catalog. `internal_code` is the internal identifier and `lc116_code` must follow the Complementary Law 116/2003 catalog (e.g. `01.05`). When `company_id` is provided, the company must belong to the authenticated organization.
Cria um método de pagamento associado a: Creates a payment method tied to a billing account. For `type=card`, send the `card` block with the `card_token` produced by client-side tokenization. For `type=bank_transfer`, send the `bank_account` block. For `bank_slip` and `pix`, only the `type` is required — the default gateway is resolved from the organization.
Cria um papel customizado. O `slug` deve: Creates a custom role. `slug` must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits and `_`.
Cria um plano para a organização autenti: Creates a plan for the authenticated organization.
Cria um template de proposta vinculado a: Creates a proposal template linked to a Google Doc or Google Slides. The `google_doc_id` must be unique per organization.
Cria uma NFe em rascunho (`draft`) para: Creates a draft (`draft`) NF-e for later issuance via `POST /nfes/{id}/issue`. Accepts taker data (`customer`) and optional tax rates.
Cria uma assinatura. É obrigatório envia: Creates a subscription. Either `plan_id` or `items` is required.
Cria uma conta de cobrança associada a u: Creates a billing account associated with a customer. The `customer` block locates an existing customer by `id`, `external_id` or `document_number`; when not found, creates a new one (requires `name` and `document_number`).
Cria uma cópia do plano (incluindo seus: Creates a copy of the plan (including its items) in draft state.
Cria uma cópia do template informado, ma: Creates a copy of the given template, keeping configuration and metadata. The new template gets a derived name.
Cria uma empresa (matriz ou filial). Par: Creates a company (head office or branch). To create a branch, provide `parent_company_id` — the CNPJ must share the same prefix as the head office. Only CNPJ companies can have branches. The first company created in the organization is flagged as `is_default` automatically.
Cria uma fatura para uma conta de cobran: Creates an invoice for a billing account. Accepts line items, optional installments (`installments`, minimum 2) and NF-e issuance policy.
Cria uma nova proposta a partir da propo: Creates a new proposal from the original (as draft), preserving items and configuration.
Cria uma nova regra para uma transição e: Creates a new rule for a plan-to-plan transition. Lets you block/allow the transition, set timing, proration, discounts and bonus days.
Cria uma nova regra tributária com seus: Creates a new tax rule along with its items (per-tax rates). The `scope` defines the applicability level and `priority` defines precedence — higher priority overrides lower. At least one entry in `items` is required.
Cria uma política. Multa e juros acima d: Creates a policy. Fine and interest above the legal ceilings (2% fine and 1% monthly interest, Brazilian Consumer Code art. 52) are refused unless `enforce_legal_caps` is `false` — which is audited separately, being a legal-risk decision.
Cria uma proposta comercial. É obrigatór: Creates a commercial proposal. You must provide `billing_account_id`, `prospect_id` or `prospect_data` (inline prospect creation).
Cronograma de parcelas (mínimo 2). Cada: Installment schedule (minimum 2). Each item has `amount` and `due_date`.
Crédito de proporção em reais (float, at: Proration credit in BRL (float, up to 4 decimal places) issued to the customer.
Crédito gerado pela conversão da retençã: Credit generated by converting the withholding.
Crédito gerado por proração em reais (fl: Credit generated by proration in sub-cents (float, up to 4 decimal places).
Créditos consumidos, na unidade do produ: Credits consumed, in the product unit (up to 6 decimal places).
Créditos em faturas de compra ainda em a: Credits on purchase invoices still open.
Custo estimado em reais (float, até 4 ca: Estimated cost in BRL (float, up to 4 decimal places). `null` when the price does not allow the calculation.
Customer to associate — existing or new.
Customer associado, presente quando a re: Associated customer, present when the relation is loaded.
Código CNAE relacionado ao serviço prest: CNAE code related to the service provided.
Código IBGE do município (7 dígitos) qua: IBGE municipality code (7 digits) when `scope = municipality`.
Código NCM (Nomenclatura Comum do Mercos: NCM code (Mercosur Common Nomenclature), when applicable.
Código de autenticidade impresso no DANF: Authenticity code printed on the NFS-e DANFSE.
Código de erro estável. Use este campo p: Stable error code. Use this field to handle errors programmatically — never parse `message`.
Failure code returned by the gateway.
Código de verificação/autenticidade impr: Verification/authenticity code printed on the DANFSE.
Código do serviço conforme a tabela muni: Service code per the municipal table.
Código interno do item — imutável depois: Internal item code — immutable after creation.
Código municipal do serviço, quando o mu: Municipal service code, when the municipality requires its own coding.
Código público do cupom — usado pelos cl: Public coupon code — used by customers when applying the discount. Unique per organization.
Código público do cupom — único por orga: Public coupon code — unique per organization.
DAS estimado (Simples Nacional), em reai: Estimated DAS (Simples Nacional), in BRL (float, up to 4 decimal places).
DAS estimado máximo do período, em reais: Maximum estimated DAS for the period, in BRL (e.g.: `5000.00`).
DAS estimado mínimo do período, em reais: Minimum estimated DAS for the period, in BRL (e.g.: `100.00`).
Dados cadastrais da organização (nome, d: Organization registration data (name, document, contacts, addresses). Always included.
Dados de cobrança opcionais (nome, e-mai: Optional billing details (name, email, phone, address) sent to the gateway.
Optional billing details (name, email, phone, address) used by the gateway.
Dados do cartão quando `payment_method =: Card data when `payment_method = card` and no `payment_method_id` is provided.
Dados livres da origem, guardados como v: Free-form data from the source, stored as sent.
Dados para criar um contato inline (pess: Data to create a contact inline (natural person in charge).

## Format

The API only accepts `JSON`. Every request must use `Content-Type: application/json`. All responses use `snake_case`.

| Field type | Format |
| :--- | :--- |
| **DateTime** | [ISO8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format. Examples — Date: `2026-01-24`. Date and time: `2026-01-24T10:07Z` |
| **Money** | Decimal number in BRL, with up to 4 decimal places. E.g.: `100.5` = R$ 100.50 |
| **UUID** | Resource identifiers as UUID v4 |

## Conventions

Conventions used in this documentation:

| Convention | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`:variable`** | A variable name that must be replaced in the URL. |
| **`#{variable}`** | A variable name that must be replaced with values from your account. |
| **`...`** | Response content truncated for readability. |
| **`$KOBANA_TOKEN`** | Access token. For command-line testing, export it: `export KOBANA_TOKEN=xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx` then paste the docs commands into your terminal. |

## Return Codes

The API returns standard HTTP status codes:

| | Code | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ✅ | **200 OK** | Successful request with a response body. |
| ✅ | **201 Created** | Resource created successfully. |
| ✅ | **204 No Content** | Successful request without a response body. |
| ❌ | **400 Bad Request** | Invalid request, usually malformed content. |
| ❌ | **401 Unauthorized** | Missing or invalid access token. |
| ❌ | **403 Forbidden** | API access blocked or user not authorized. |
| ❌ | **404 Not Found** | Resource not found. |
| ❌ | **422 Unprocessable Entity** | Valid request, but the data is not. |
| ❌ | **429 Too Many Requests** | Rate limit reached. |
| ❌ | **500 Internal Server Error** | Internal processing error. Check [server status](https://status.kobana.com.br). |

## Request ID

Every request has an associated identifier in the `Request-Id` response header. This value helps with debugging and auditing — requests and their IDs are available in the system dashboard. Request logs are retained for **30 days**. When opening a support ticket about a specific request, provide the `Request-Id` to speed up the investigation.

## Security

The Kobana API uses **2048-bit SSL** certificates. Every request must use **HTTPS** — calls on port 80 are redirected to 443.

Clients must support `TLSv1.2` or `TLSv1.3` with one of the ciphers: `TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256`, `TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384`, `TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256`, `ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256`, `ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256`, `ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384`, `ECDHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305`, `ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384`. `TLSv1` and `TLSv1.1` are not supported.

## HTTP Caching

Use HTTP cache headers to reduce load and improve speed. Most responses include `ETag` and/or `Last-Modified` — store these values and send them back on follow-up requests via `If-None-Match` and `If-Modified-Since`. If the resource hasn't changed you'll get `304 Not Modified` — no body, no reprocessing. More info: [HTTP Cache Docs](http://www.mnot.net/cache_docs/).

## Error Handling

5xx errors mean a server failure: **500 Internal Server Error** (application unavailable), **502 Bad Gateway**, **503 Service Unavailable** and **504 Gateway Timeout** (point-in-time infrastructure failures). Your application must catch these and retry the request after a few minutes with backoff. Server status: [https://status.kobana.com.br](https://status.kobana.com.br).

## Monetary values

Every monetary value — in requests and responses — is a decimal number in BRL, with up to 4 decimal places. There are no cent-based fields: send `100.5` for R$ 100.50 and `0.0125` for R$ 0.0125. Pricing fields keep all 4 decimals; the others are rounded to 2.
